title: The Secret of Friendship
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume shoujo high-school story written by Kazune Kawahara and drawn by Aiji Yamakawa. Shy, plain Eiko and beautiful, envied Moe are inseparable best friends; Moe will only date a boy who values Eiko more than her, and when a boy named Tsuchida seems to meet that condition, the friendship starts to shift (Seven Seas blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates). The volume also includes a separate one-shot.
life_message: Loyal friendship between girls is worth as much as romance, and being truly seen matters more than looks.
